title: Typed React Query
description: Implement type-safe data fetching with React Query and TypeScript.

data.text: React Query (TanStack Query) combined with TypeScript provides type-safe data fetching, caching, and state management.

data.title: Typed Query
Type Inference
data.text: React Query infers types from queryFn return values. You can also explicitly type the query result for better control.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use queryKey arrays with typed parameters
Leverage TypeScript for API response types
Handle loading and error states safely
data.takeaway: Type-safe queries prevent runtime errors and improve developer experience.
